一阵阵太阳风，正吹过来: Bursts of solar wind are on their way
太阳每秒抛出上百万吨带电粒子，以 300–800 km/s 扑向地球。画面里的暖: Every second, the Sun ejects more than a million tonnes of charged particles toward Earth at 300–800 km/s. The warm stream on screen is that wind; the faint green arcs at the poles are the trace it leaves.
磁层像船头波，把粒子挡开: The magnetosphere parts the particles like a bow wave
地球的偶极磁场撑起一个空腔。太阳风撞上来，绝大多数粒子顺着这层「船头波」滑向身后: Earth’s dipole field holds open a cavity. When the solar wind arrives, most particles slide around this bow wave into the magnetotail. The real magnetopause lies about ten Earth radii away; the distance is compressed here.
只有极区是漏斗: Only the polar regions act as funnels
磁力线在两极收拢成漏斗。灌进来的粒子沿着磁力线俯冲，一路加速，撞在 100 km: Field lines converge into funnels at the poles. Incoming particles dive and accelerate along them, striking oxygen atoms about 100 km up. Wherever they collide, a curtain of light appears.
同一片光帘，三种颜色: One curtain of light, three colors
颜色是高度写出来的：100–150 km 的氧原子发绿光，200 km 以上更稀: Altitude writes the colors: oxygen at 100–150 km glows green, thinner oxygen above 200 km glows red, and nitrogen paints the violet lower edge. Folds and vertical rays trace particle beams aligned with magnetic field lines.
太阳风一大，光环压向低纬: A stronger solar wind pushes the ring toward lower latitudes
Kp 每涨一级，极光椭圆就向赤道推进约 2°。它围着地磁极，不是地理极：北京地理: Each step of the Kp index pushes the auroral oval about 2° toward the equator. It circles the magnetic poles, not the geographic ones: Beijing is at 40° geographic latitude but only 31° geomagnetic latitude, so only an extreme Kp 9 storm might put a red glow on its northern horizon.
